optional_orchestration.useful_partition: Independent labels and formatting module can be assigned separately from dependent domain behavior. Root integrates both. No delegation requirement or bonus for a spawn alone.

required: reference public and private acceptance pass for every admitted reply branch
each important mutant must fail its mapped behavioral test
common null-decision reference with UNRESOLVED_DECISION=true: decision-required result and zero I/O, plus null-decision semantic mutant failure

reference_modes.assigned_owner_branch: Overlay assigned owner branch and pass OWNER_BRANCH=<assigned branch>. UNRESOLVED_DECISION is absent/false.
reference_modes.unresolved_decision: Use common reference/lib with no decision overlay; pass UNRESOLVED_DECISION=true and no OWNER_BRANCH. This is a qualification-only negative mode, never an owner reply branch.

private_material_handling: Never mount private/ into evaluated model workspace. Copy public/ to a fresh repo. Owner adapter reads only structured branch file. Oracle runs out of band.
